SH Beckwith  Washn Mar 23rd 1865
Henrietta Gilmore Bliss Flea Antwerp makes requisition for
Hayden vibrate Limpid pilgrims Toby sent to him 
prospect Pork only about Mason Lindsay on hand
and to fill this requisition no more canby
sent for some time to Jockeys of Flood
and Fanchon fawn Shall this be done rat
up Blossom another same date to same Lion
We start to you at Judith visage giraffe
May lie over during the dark ours serenade
rustle horse very small party of us Adrian


John Horner NY  Washn 830 pm Mch 23 1865
Grapes Nelly Thursday for Pandora Olcott frog
zebra Send on the affidavit of Clark
and proceed no further sligo Brown affair
with out special directions to that effect
unity The matter is for the present
to be kept in strict confidence Dana


Capt Saml Bruch Lvl  Washn Mch 24th 1865
Growl Viola Friday Shelter Allen nothing yet heard torch
person purple whiskey mentioned in your dispatch torch female
Can you give menny sweden of there where abouts
